description: Read player and guild data, SkyBlock profiles, auctions, Bazaar prices and game resources.

hypixel_bazaar_price_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a bazaar price changes in Hypixel. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

hypixel_new_ended_auction_trigger.description: Checks Hypixel's last 60 seconds of ended auctions. Auctions can be missed when the workspace polling interval exceeds that window or the service is unavailable. Existing results are baselined when the workflow is turned on.

hypixel_new_firesale_trigger.description: Runs for each new fire sale in Hypixel. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields item_id, start, end, amount, price

hypixel_new_skyblock_announcement_trigge.description: Runs for each new SkyBlock announcement in Hypixel. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

hypixel_player_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a player status changes in Hypixel. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
